scenes.title: Level 8: Power chords
scenes.subtitle: Rock and riffs
lines: Three chords — E5, A5, D5 — all using the same shape.
Palm muting adds that chunky rhythm.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll play E5, A5 and D5 power chords, use one shape for any power chord, and add palm muting to your rhythm.
These skills will help you play rock riffs and build your confidence on the guitar.
Let's explore the power chords: E, A, D, G, C and F.
They're simple, strong and perfect for beginners.
Let's start with power chords — the building blocks of rock and riffs.
